items.name: list_files
items.description: The starting path to list from (empty string means root directory)

items.name: list_kernels
items.description: List all available kernels in the Jupyter server. This tool shows all running and available kernel sessions on the Jupyter server, including their IDs, names, states, connection information, and kernel specifications. Useful for monitoring kernel resources and identifying specific kernels for connection.

items.name: use_notebook
items.description: Unique identifier for the notebook

items.name: list_notebooks
items.description: List all notebooks that have been used via use_notebook tool

items.name: restart_notebook
items.description: Restart the kernel for a specific notebook.

items.name: unuse_notebook
items.description: Unuse from a specific notebook and release its resources.

items.name: read_notebook
items.description: Notebook identifier to read

items.name: insert_cell
items.description: Target index for insertion (0-based), use -1 to append at end

items.name: overwrite_cell_source
items.description: Index of the cell to overwrite (0-based). Omit when passing cell_id.

items.name: edit_cell_source
items.description: Index of the cell to edit (0-based). Omit when passing cell_id.

items.name: execute_cell
items.description: Index of the cell to execute (0-based). Omit when passing cell_id.

items.name: insert_execute_code_cell
items.description: Index of the cell to insert and execute (0-based)

items.name: read_cell
items.description: Index of the cell to read (0-based). Omit when passing cell_id.

items.name: delete_cell
items.description: List of cell indices to delete (0-based). Omit when passing cell_ids_to_delete.

items.name: clear_cell_output
items.description: Index of the code cell to clear (0-based). Omit when passing cell_id.

items.name: move_cell
items.description: Index of the cell to move (0-based). Omit when passing source_cell_id.

items.name: execute_code
items.description: Code to execute (supports magic commands with %, shell commands with !)

items.name: connect_to_jupyter
items.description: Jupyter server URL to connect to (e.g., 'http://localhost:8888')

items.name: jupyter_cite
items.description: User prompt for the cited cells

items.name: launch_sandbox
items.description: Unique sandbox identifier used by list/use/terminate tools

items.name: list_sandboxes
items.description: List launched code sandboxes that can be used as alternatives to kernels.

items.name: use_sandbox
items.description: Select which launched sandbox execute_code should use instead of kernels.

items.name: terminate_sandbox
items.description: Terminate a launched code sandbox.
